claims.statement: DOE guidance says compressed-air leaks often waste 20-30% of compressor output, and an established vendor actively offers leak-detection audit programs, grounding both the loss and purchased workaround.

Enterprises above the specified energy-consumption threshold must undergo an audit absent an energy-management system, placing a near-term compliance and efficiency budget with management; no evidence shows they prefer a shared-savings specialist.
A plausible control path is a 12-24 month baseline and verification contract with an accredited-auditor or field-service partner, but no plant, auditor, or data agreement is secured.
The current consolidated EU directive sets 11 October 2026 as the first-audit deadline for covered enterprises, creating a time-bounded labor allocation signal.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: Plant manager, operations director, energy manager, maintenance lead, or CFO
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Vendor-neutral measurement, repair persistence, transparent baseline rules, and payment tied to verified savings must beat equipment-led audits
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: Plant owns operations and vendor relationships; no venture contract or data right exists
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Accredited energy auditor, compressor service company, industrial equipment distributor, or direct account-based outreach

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Auditor or service-partner share, industrial sales cycles, and site qualification
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Survey deposit upfront; performance fee arrives after repair and a measurement period
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Potentially high on large verified leaks but dependent on customer repairs, baseline stability, site travel, and collection
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Baseline design, leak tagging, work-order coordination, remeasurement, and management reporting
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Safety training, site insurance, equipment calibration, legal drafting, data security, and accounting
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Target 12,000-25,000 PLN initial survey plus 20-30% of independently verified first-year savings
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Qualified field survey labor, travel, temporary meters, calibration, data processing, and independent verification

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Compressor OEMs, energy service companies, accredited auditors, and maintenance contractors already offer audits and can add monitoring
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: Initial survey and verified post-repair kWh savings are paid; measurable loss is compressor output and electricity consumed by leaks plus capacity and maintenance effects
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: Mandatory or voluntary energy audit, compressor-capacity expansion proposal, high energy bill, pressure complaint, or sustainability action plan
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Quarterly re-survey and annual baseline or savings-contract renewal

contrary_evidence: Compressor vendors already sell leak audits and may be trusted incumbents with repair capability.
The DOE loss range is a general benchmark, not evidence that any target Polish plant has a profitable leak backlog.
Formal energy audits may need registered or accredited experts, a status the founder does not hold.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Proposed 12-24 month measurement-and-savings agreement with baseline, repair responsibilities, and data rights; none secured
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Sell a fixed-price tagged leak survey and exportable action list through an accredited auditor or compressor service partner
critical_control_point.current_owner: The manufacturing plant and its existing compressor or energy-service providers
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: Plant owns operations and vendor relationships; no venture contract or data right exists
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: Public energy-audit rules and industrial leak guidance are available for lawful prospecting; no plant access, meter data, accredited-auditor role, or savings contract is held
critical_control_point.renewal: Proposed annual renewal after baseline reconciliation
critical_control_point.subject: Compressed-air baseline, tagged repair backlog, and savings-verification workflow

economics.acquisition_route: Accredited energy auditors, compressor service firms, equipment distributors, and account-based outreach to qualifying plants
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Conditional path: 80 plants producing 100,000 PLN average annual revenue equals 8m PLN revenue; a repeatable measurement platform and channel could exceed 5m PLN in value, but sales cycles and savings attribution are unknown
economics.founder_time: Two or three concurrent sites can fit 3-5 hours daily if field surveys and repairs are performed by partners
economics.gross_margin_basis: Survey and performance fees less field labor, meters, travel, verification, partner share, acquisition, safety, and insurance
economics.payback: Target customer payback inside 12 months after repair; plant-specific evidence is absent
economics.pricing: Discovery hypothesis: 12,000-25,000 PLN survey plus 20-30% of independently verified first-year savings
economics.retention_or_repeat: Quarterly or annual re-survey and expansion to additional lines or plants

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Leak signature, repair cost, persistence, operating schedule, and verified savings data improve prioritization and baseline accuracy
fingerprint.customer: Polish manufacturing plants with material compressed-air systems and limited in-house energy analytics
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Accredited energy auditors, compressor service firms, industrial insurers, equipment distributors, and factory associations
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Sensor-assisted compressed-air leak survey, repair work-order coordination, measurement and verification, and shared-savings reporting
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Plant pays an initial survey and then a contracted share when independently measured energy savings persist after repairs
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Energy-audit deadline, high compressor load, unexplained pressure loss, capacity constraint, or management demand for a quantified action plan

founder_fit: Time-series baselining, anomaly detection, and measurement uncertainty fit data-science skills
Savings and repair persistence create objective commercial outcomes
Auditor and service channels can provide field labor while the founder builds analysis and workflow automation
A few high-value industrial contracts may fit the employment constraint better than a large consumer support load
risks: Industrial site safety and liability exceed a software-only project
Customer production changes can make savings attribution contentious
Plants may take the survey and defer repairs, preventing performance revenue
Incumbent OEMs can bundle audits with service contracts

structural_signature.control_point_descriptor: contracted baseline repair backlog and repeat verification loop inside plant operations
structural_signature.critical_dependency_descriptor: plant must permit measurement execute repairs and accept a savings baseline

structure.control_point: Contracted operating relationship around the plant's metering baseline and repair-verification loop
structure.critical_dependency: Plant adoption of metering and repairs plus credible independent measurement and verification

thesis: Observed labor and purchasing change: EU rules require enterprises above the 10 TJ threshold without an energy-management system to receive a first energy audit by 11 October 2026, while established compressor vendors sell leak-audit programs and the U.S. Department of Energy documents leakage commonly wasting 20-30% of compressor output. Sell mid-sized factories a bounded compressed-air baseline, tagged leak survey, repair verification, and ongoing metering service, charging a fixed audit fee plus a share of independently measured savings.
title: Metered Compressed-Air Savings Share
uncertainties: Number and accessibility of Polish plants above the audit threshold with material compressed-air loads
Accredited-auditor and field-partner cost and willingness to share customer relationships
Baseline stability across production changes and customer acceptance of measurement rules
Repair execution rate, savings persistence, and sales-cycle duration
